results.evidence: Two trip reports of the same three-day Monument + Lake Mountain outing give different car-to-car totals: one 31 mi and 13,200 ft gained and lost, the other 32.2 mi and 12,136 ft. Both support the itinerary totalNote range (~12,000-13,200 ft) and show gain_ft 7,567 and the day sum 9,900 are both too low for the itinerary as written, but the two sources do not agree on one figure, and no source states a Monument-only car-to-car total. Per the rules gain_ft is not recomputed and day figures are not traded; left open.

The contradiction is real: the day-2 schedule (camp ~7,000-7,100 -> 7,400 saddle -> 6,100 basin -> 8,597 summit and back over the saddle) implies roughly 4,000+ ft of gain, not 2,600. One trip report confirms the same saddle (7,400) and basin (6,100) elevations but states no summit-day gain figure. Changing the day's gainFt would break the itinerary total against gain_ft, which is itself unresolved, so no patch.

results.fact: Pistol Pass to Lake of the Woods
results.correct_value: About a mile down from Pistol Pass on the trail, finishing on a short (~1/4 mi) spur to the lake; not 3 miles of cross-country side-hilling.
results.evidence: One trip report describes reaching Pistol Pass and then 'a mile down to camp' at Lake of the Woods. A second describes losing about 700 ft beyond the pass on the main trail and then taking a spur trail about a quarter mile to the lake. Both agree it is ~1 mile and on trail, matching the waypoints (11 -> 12 mi) and the 12-mile day-1 total; the approach's '3 miles cross-country south' and the lake waypoint's 'side-hill cross-country' wording are wrong.
